name: wireguard-public
description: Owner of the wg-public mesh topology + client list. Data-only entry (enabled=false → no container/compose). Replaces the previous wireguard_public block that lived in config.json (root global), so adding/rotating/sharing a wg-public client is a one-file edit here instead of touching the global config.
_doc: Engine contract: cloud-data-config-consolidated.ts reads .wireguard_public from THIS build.json (preferred) before falling back to config.json::native.wireguard_public during the migration window. Final state after migration is to remove the config.json copy entirely.

wireguard_public._doc: Public-trust WG mesh. VM members: oci-analytics (hub — the only fully-public VM), gcp-proxy, oci-mail, oci-apps. Compromise blast radius bounded — wg-public peers reach only public-facing services, not internal wg0 services. Operator policy (2026-05-23): wg0 is the private admin mesh; wg-public is open-enrollment.
wireguard_public._port_fallback_doc: Hotel-WiFi/airport-network resistance: hub also accepts handshake on udp/443 (PREROUTING REDIRECT → udp/51821). Same mechanism wg0 uses. The two meshes' fallbacks coexist because their hubs are on different VMs (wg0 hub gcp-proxy 35.226.147.64 / wg-public hub oci-analytics 129.151.228.66) — each REDIRECT is local to its own host.

termux._doc: Diego's phone — same X25519 identity as wg0 termux (the operator's unified personal credential). The vault dir termux-public/ mirrors the pubkey from termux/.

termux-share._doc: Shareable wg-public credential held on Diego's phone. Separate keypair from 'termux' (vault dir termux-share-public/) so rotating/revoking this one doesn't affect personal admin access. Designed for handout: someone gets ONLY wg-public access (10.1.0.0/24), never wg0.

health-runner._doc: URL-health prober (cloud-data reports container in GHA). Joins wg-public as a spoke so it can probe hub-bound services (e.g. cf-worker-bridge on 10.1.0.1:8092) — its wg0 identity (gha-runner, 10.0.0.200) only routes 10.0.0.0/24. Keypair: vault dir health-runner-public/; private key mirrored to the cloud-data repo GHA secret WG_PUBLIC_PRIVATE_KEY consumed by reports/entrypoint.sh wg1 block.
